# SOLREIGN — Standard Asset Agreement
[color=#9BEC00]INTERNAL DISTRIBUTION — READ BEFORE YOUR FIRST SHIFT[/color]
Congratulations on your provisional employment, asset. Solreign runs on ambition, initiative, and a healthy disregard for Nanotrasen's cowardice. The following clauses are not suggestions — the Season Ledger records your compliance.
## Clause 1 — Management Is Always Right Admins are Solreign Regional Management. Their word is final. File grievances through [bold]ahelp (press F1)[/bold] — never by shouting in OOC.
## Clause 2 — Sanctioned Chaos Solreign does not fear ambition. [bold]Self Antag is permitted[/bold] — scheme, betray, seize power, and make your own trouble the Solreign way. But chaos is a company resource: keep it fun for the crew around you, not a tool to bully one player out of their round.
## Clause 3 — Decency Is Mandatory (Zero Tolerance) No slurs, hate speech, or real-world bigotry. No sexual content, erotic roleplay (ERP), or shock material. Solreign is a family megacorp — violations mean immediate termination (a ban), no warning.
## Clause 4 — Fair Play No cheating, exploits, hacking, or alternate accounts. Found a company defect (a bug)? Report it to Management — do not weaponize it.
## Clause 5 — Corporate Language Conduct OOC, LOOC, and ahelp in English so Management can serve every asset.
## Clause 6 — Stay On Brand You are a Solreign asset — play the part. Keep out-of-character talk in OOC/LOOC and let the round breathe.
[italic]Your file is open. Your titles are earned. Compliance is its own reward.[/italic] [italic]— Solreign Human Resources[/italic]
